name: Magic Wallet  v2 - w/ Dualstrusion and Printable Straps

captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of four separate flat components laid out for printing: two identical large rectangular panels and three long, thin strap pieces. The two main panels feature rectangular slot cutouts near their edges to accommodate the straps, with two slots on one long edge and one centered slot on the opposite edge. The straps are designed with small raised end-stops to secure them in place once threaded through the panel slots.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric magic wallet in OpenSCAD with two main rectangular side panels and connecting straps. The panels should have customizable dimensions, thickness, and slot sizes to fit the straps, and the straps themselves should have adjustable clearance tolerances and thickness.
captions.factory: The code defines two main modules, 'magicWallet_side1' and 'magicWallet_side2', which use a difference() operation to subtract rectangular slot cutouts (created with 'cube') from the main base plates. The strap modules, 'smallStraps' and 'bigStraps', use a difference of 'cube' primitives to create flat bands with recessed channels, applying a 'fit_tol' variable to ensure proper clearance. Custom text or surface images can be optionally rendered on the panels using the external 'write' library and 'surface' function.
